admission.contract: A caller-supplied contiguous frame buffer passes minimal frame parsing and is converted into a `blosc2_schunk` backed by the same in-memory frame object.
admission.predicate: a1.hit && a2.hit && a1.time <= a2.time && a1.frame_ptr == a2.frame_ptr && a1.frame_cframe != 0 && a2.schunk_ptr != 0
limitations: The public issue names a frame decompression fuzz target but the harness entry was not inspected, so the exact admission API is source-derived.
This contract binds acceptance to `blosc2_schunk_from_buffer`/`frame_from_cframe`; another public frame-loading API could also reach the same vulnerable path.

root.contract: `frame_get_lazychunk` enters the in-memory-frame path, aliases `*chunk` into `frame->cframe`, and simultaneously detects that the computed chunk header extends past `frame->len` while ownership remains false.
limitations: The issue text does not expose the malformed frame fields that force this state; the binding comes from the contiguous-frame error branch in source.
This captures the root state only for the in-memory frame path, not for file-backed frames that allocate a separate lazy chunk buffer.

target.contract: The error cleanup in `frame_get_lazychunk` frees the same non-owned interior `frame->cframe` pointer after the out-of-bounds-header condition set `rc < 0`.
target.predicate: root.r1.hit && t1.hit && root.r1.time <= t1.time && t1.frame_has_cframe && t1.rc < 0 && !t1.owns_chunk && t1.chunk_ptr == root.r1.chunk_ptr
limitations: This contract binds to the explicit `free(*chunk)` call site, not to a particular allocator or sanitizer diagnostic.
The invalid-free classification is inferred from `free` consuming a non-owned interior frame pointer; the issue text provides no reproducer bytes to prove the exact offset value at runtime.
